intro
This is the King James Bible app. A fully featured Bible, King James only, and free for your church, now and always.
read
It is made, first of all, for reading. Open it, and the Verse of the Day is waiting for you. You can even have it sent to your phone each morning.
chapter
Choose any book and chapter, and the Word is set in clear, restful type, in a dark, light, or sepia theme. At the end of each chapter, your Reading Journal is ready for your thoughts.
romans
Romans Road is front and center, on the home page, ready to win souls.
audio
Would you rather listen? Alexander Scourby's reading of the King James Bible plays chapter by chapter, or straight through a whole book, with a sleep timer for the evening.
plans
Reading plans walk you through Proverbs in a month, the New Testament in thirty days, or the whole Bible in a year. Or make a plan of your own, at your own pace.
streak
Every day you read, your streak grows. Each week of faithful reading earns a shield that covers a missed day, and your reading calendar collects badges for chapters, whole books, and the whole Bible.
search
For the serious student, search finds any word or phrase in the King James Bible, and takes you straight to the chapter.
card
Tap any verse to open its verse card. The meaning of its words, the Hebrew and Greek behind them, cross references, and the doctrines it teaches.
back
Every reference opens Scripture, and the back button always returns you right where you were reading.
tools
Behind the search tab is a whole library of study tools.
concord
A concordance of every word in the King James Bible, and every verse it is found in.
dict
Webster's 1828 dictionary, with plain notes on older King James words.
strongs
Strong's Hebrew and Greek, the original words behind the English.
topics
Nave's Topical Bible, with thousands of topics and the verses on each one.
doct
The primary doctrines of the faith, each one shown from Scripture.
maps

Maps, and the journeys of Abraham, Moses, David, Jesus earthly ministry, and Paul's travels, stop by stop, with the verses linked to each location on their routes, and map references for any location in a given chapter.
timeline
A Biblical timeline, from Creation to Revelation, every event tied to its passage.
hymns
Two hundred and twenty four classic hymns of the faith, and Bible names, with their meanings.
glow
And Verse Glow, a screensaver of Scripture. One verse gently fades into the next, full screen. Leave it on a tablet, a television, or a screen in the church foyer.
keep

As you read, keep what you find. Highlight verses in your own colours, organized with your own custom labels, and save them to My Verses, customized lists you create, for a doctrine, a lesson, or comfort.
notes
Adding verses to your study notes is just as easy. Press and hold a verse, tap Study, and it is in your notes with its reference. Tap the reference any time, to go back to the chapter.
drill
Sword Drill is a Bible memorization game that helps you hide God's word in your heart, one verse at a time.
drill2

It keeps a daily streak, awards badges and certificates, let's you unlocks new verse packs as you progress, from Foundation to Wisdom, the Prophets, the Psalms and more. Even your own curated list of scripture to memorize, and modes that are rewarding and challenging to all ages and levels. A wonderful encouragement for young and old to memorize the Bible.
share
Sharing Scripture is simple. Turn any verse into a downloadable graphic, using beautiful, premade scenes, or upload your own photo, and share it by text, email, or social media.
links
Any verse, passage, or hymn can be shared as a link that opens right to it, and hymn lyrics make lovely cards, too.
tips
Tips and Help is always one tap away, and every tool has its own short guide.
privacy
Your privacy is kept. There are no accounts, no names or email addresses, no ads, and nothing is ever sold. A simple backup code keeps your notes safe across your devices. Your data is yours!
laptop
On a laptop, your study notes sit right beside the Bible, so you can write a lesson or a sermon with the chapter open, adding references from any study source.
present
And when it is time to teach, you can present the passage on the big screen, one verse at a time, for church, a class, or a Bible study.
outro
The King James Bible app. Free forever. It works on any phone, tablet, or computer, even offline. Everything leads back to the Word. Visit F B C K J V dot app, slash K J V Bible.
